test_title: PYST 6: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/698ab3923a66d74cc5f5b267c87f76e1e3af95a9b0137f7a8688dafbccf97bee.png]
solution:
From the dice I and dice II:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/578f0ab015396aa480e14f64cb420cd8ebd8cbc7f2adc9e3d17f706a95d8e10e.png] 

→ 4 is opposite of 2.

From Dice II and Dice III:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/836e0324718135f742698945cc0e3a72b92b744dab97ea56679dc598df53c583.png] 

→ 5 is opposite of 6.

Thus, 1 is opposite of 3.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
